heroIntro: Kadi Limo & Transportation provides private, chauffeured rides across Atlanta for airport transfers, business travel, weddings and the occasions worth getting right.
introHeading: A calmer way to get where you’re going
introBody: Good transportation is mostly invisible. The car is ready, the route is planned, and you spend the ride on the call, the conversation or the moment — not on directions, parking or timing.
Tell us where you need to be and when. We’ll review the details, confirm what we can offer, and reply with availability and a quote.
aboutIntro: Kadi Limo & Transportation is a private car service based in Atlanta, Georgia, offering chauffeured transportation in a black fleet of SUVs, sedans and specialty vehicles.
aboutBody: We work with individuals, families and organizations who want one less thing to manage — whether that’s an early airport run, a day of client meetings, or a wedding schedule with very little room for error.

Every trip starts with a conversation about what you actually need: who is riding, where, when, and what matters most. From there we recommend a suitable vehicle, confirm availability and send a clear quote before anything is booked.

principles.title: Clear communication
principles.body: You’ll know what’s confirmed and what isn’t. We reply with availability and a quote, and only confirm a booking once the details are settled.

principles.title: Planned around you
principles.body: Pickup times, stops and timing are planned around your schedule, not the other way round.

principles.title: Quiet professionalism
principles.body: A clean vehicle, a courteous chauffeur and a ride that lets you focus on your day.

contactIntro: Share the details of your trip and we’ll reply with availability and a quote. Nothing is booked until we confirm it with you.

title: Airport & hotel transfers
summary: Rides to and from the airport, hotels and your home, planned around your travel times.
description: Start or end a trip without searching for parking or waiting in a rideshare line. Share your travel details when you request a quote, and we’ll plan a pickup time that leaves comfortable room for traffic and check-in.

title: Corporate & executive transportation
summary: Dependable transportation for meetings, roadshows, client visits and business travel.
description: For days with tight schedules and important people. We can plan single rides or multi-stop itineraries so executives, clients and visiting teams move between meetings without distraction.

title: Weddings
summary: Transportation for the couple, wedding party and family, coordinated with your day’s timeline.
description: Weddings run on timing. We’ll work from your schedule — getting ready, ceremony, photos, reception and the send-off — and recommend vehicles that suit your party and your plans.

title: Proms & formal events
summary: A memorable, well-organized ride for proms, galas and black-tie evenings.
description: Make the arrival part of the evening. Tell us about the group, pickup points and timing, and we’ll help plan a ride that’s organized for the guests and reassuring for parents and hosts.

title: Birthdays & private celebrations
summary: Chauffeured transportation for birthdays, anniversaries and nights out.
description: Celebrate without worrying about the drive home. Whether it’s dinner for two or an evening with friends, we’ll plan pickups and stops so everyone can enjoy the occasion.

title: Concerts & sporting events
summary: Skip the parking and traffic stress on game days and show nights.
description: Get to the stadium, arena or venue and back again without hunting for parking. Share the event, venue and timing, and we’ll plan drop-off and pickup details with you in advance.

title: Hourly chauffeur service
summary: A car and chauffeur at your disposal for a set block of time.
description: Useful when your plans include several stops or uncertain timing — errands, appointments, site visits or an evening out. Tell us roughly how long you need and where you expect to go.

title: Point-to-point rides
summary: A direct ride from one address to another, booked in advance.
description: Simple and direct: we pick you up at one location and take you to the next. A good fit for dinners, appointments, events and any trip where you’d rather not drive.

title: Group transportation
summary: Moving a group together, when a suitable vehicle is available.
description: Keep a group together for weddings, corporate outings, celebrations and events. Share your group size and plans, and we’ll let you know which options are available for your date.
note: Group options depend on vehicle availability for your date. We’ll confirm what we can offer when we reply.

name: Cadillac Escalade
description: A full-size SUV with a confident presence, well suited to airport transfers, executive travel and evenings out.

name: Chevrolet Suburban
description: A practical, spacious SUV that works well for airport runs, family trips and small groups traveling together.

name: GMC Yukon
description: A comfortable full-size SUV for business travel, airport transfers and point-to-point rides around Atlanta.

name: Cadillac CT5 or XTS sedan
description: A refined sedan for one-on-one business travel, airport transfers and a quiet ride to dinner.

name: Stretch limousine
description: A classic choice for weddings, proms, birthdays and celebrations where the ride is part of the occasion.

name: Rolls-Royce
description: Reserved for the moments that call for something special — wedding arrivals, anniversaries and milestone events.
